detail.main_tasks:
• As a Software Engineer on the Revenue team, you will work on the hardest technical problems that stand between a new partnership and live revenue: debugging real production environments, identifying root causes across complex web and ad systems, and turning these learning into product and infrastructure improvements.
• This is an engineering role first.
• You will write code, investigate ambiguous failures, improve deployment and diagnostic systems, and work closely with product engineering, account management, and partnerships to make Ad-Shield easier, faster, and more reliable to launch at scale.
• In practice, this is one of the highest-impact roles at Ad-Shield through forward‑deployed engineering (FDE): you see real customer environments, discover where the systems are not enough, and push those learnings back into the product and platform.
• Every fix you ship can unlock new revenue and improve the product for every future customer.
• Connect Engineering Work Directly to Revenue: Prioritize technical work based on business impact.
• Own Root Cause and Problem Space: You will trace ambiguous issues to their true source, understand why they happened, and decide whether the right resolution is a code change, configuration strategy, monitoring improvement, product enhancement, or a clear technical explanation that helps Account Managers guide the customer.
• Investigate Revenue‑Blocking Issues in Real Environments: Debug complex production problems that affect customer launches, revenue activation, or product reliability.
• Partner Internally, Own the Technical Path: Work closely with Partnership Managers and Clients to understand issue context, ask the right technical questions, and provide clear internal findings.
• Improve Launch Reliability at Scale: Help Ad‑Shield move from issue‑by‑issue debugging to scalable launch infrastructure.
detail.intro:
## About Ad-Shield
• Billions of ad impressions disappear every day because of ad blockers, destroying over $200B in publisher revenue annually. Ad-Shield builds next-generation adblock recovery technology that helps publisher restore this lost revenue and turn blocked traffic into a sustainable revenue channel.

• We are one of the fastest-growing teams in global ad-tech. With a lean, high-leverage team, we generate millions of dollars in revenue per employee and are scaling an 8-figure net revenue portfolio toward 9-figure potential.


## About the Role
• As a Software Engineer on the Revenue team, you will work on the hardest technical problems that stand between a new partnership and live revenue: debugging real production environments, identifying root causes across complex web and ad systems, and turning these learning into product and infrastructure improvements.

• This is an engineering role first. You will write code, investigate ambiguous failures, improve deployment and diagnostic systems, and work closely with product engineering, account management, and partnerships to make Ad-Shield easier, faster, and more reliable to launch at scale.

• In practice, this is one of the highest-impact roles at Ad-Shield through forward‑deployed engineering (FDE): you see real customer environments, discover where the systems are not enough, and push those learnings back into the product and platform. Every fix you ship can unlock new revenue and improve the product for every future customer.

•  As more coding gets automated, the hard part of engineering becomes understanding real‑world client problems and designing systems around them. This role puts you directly in that lane and empowers you to develop human judgment about which problems matter and how to keep systems working for live customers, a combination that is hard to automate and valuable in any future role.

‍
detail.benefits:
## Benefits & Perks
• Flexible Remote Work. We trust you to decide where you work best. No rigid office mandates.
•  Annual Leave, Granted Upfront. We front-load your annual leave so you can take time off when you actually need it, not when you've earned enough days.
•  Lunch Covered. A daily lunch allowance, on us.
•  Snacks and Beverages. The office pantry is always stocked.
•  Global Exposure. Opportunities for business trips to the U.S. and to work directly from our U.S. office alongside the team there.
•  AI Tooling Covered. We cover the cost of the AI tools that make your work better. Use whatever helps you move faster.
• Relocation support. We provide assistance for candidates relocating to join us.
detail.preferred_points:
• AdTech or Publisher Monetization Experience: Familiarity with Google Ad Manager, Prebid, header bidding, programmatic advertising, or ad blockers.
• Production JavaScript Debugging Experience: Experience debugging browser-based JavaScript in complex environments with third-party scripts or inconsistent client-side behavior.
• Edge or Infrastructure Experience: Familiarity with Cloudflare Workers, CDNs, caching, edge computing, or web security models.
• Startup Operating Experience: Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where technical decisions have direct and visible business impact.
